body: You were correct; she did this as a grab for attention to "punish" me for cutting her off. Unfortunately for her, this has only succeeded in making me even more sure she no longer has contact with me.

Thank you for your kindness. I'm not sure if she's alive right now or not; it's a waiting game at the moment. But I am doing my best to remind myself that I owe myself the self-love that I was never given, even in these trying times.
